text: Service Notice - Authentication Service. We identified an issue affecting token refresh for some API integrations beginning at approximately 08:30 UTC. Our team has identified the root cause and is deploying a fix. ETA: 10:00 UTC.
Resolved - Authentication Service. The token refresh issue has been fully resolved as of 09:50 UTC. Duration: ~80 minutes. Root cause: Configuration error in a recent deployment (rolled back).
